subject: Physics
title: Electromagnetic Induction
summary: Jab bhi kisi coil se guzarne wala magnetic flux Φ = B·A badalta hai, coil mein emf induce hota hai (Faraday). Flux teen tarah badal sakta hai: B badle, area badle (rod khiske), ya angle badle (coil ghoome — generator).
Induced current ki direction hamesha aisi hoti hai ki woh flux ke BADLAAV ka virodh kare (Lenz's law) — yeh energy conservation ka seedha nateeja hai. Isliye formula mein minus sign: ε = −N dΦ/dt.

Coil apne hi current ke badlaav ka virodh karti hai — self inductance L (ε = −L dI/dt), aur paas wali coil mein emf jagaati hai — mutual inductance M. Inductor energy ½LI² magnetic field mein store karta hai.
Metal ke tukde mein badalta flux gol-gol currents (eddy currents) banata hai — braking, induction furnace mein kaam ke, transformer core mein nuksaan (isliye laminated core).

formulas.name: Magnetic flux
formulas.formula: Φ = B·A = BA cosθ;   N turns: NΦ (flux linkage);   unit weber (T·m²)
formulas.when: Coil se kitna field guzar raha hai.
formulas.mistake: θ B aur area ke NORMAL ke beech, coil ke plane ke beech nahi.

formulas.name: Faraday's law
formulas.mistake: Flux zyada hona emf nahi deta — flux ka BADALNA deta hai.

formulas.name: Lenz's law
formulas.formula: Induced current flux ke badlaav ka virodh karta hai (minus sign)
formulas.mistake: Current flux ka virodh nahi, flux ke CHANGE ka virodh karta hai — flux badh raha ho to ulta field, ghat raha ho to same direction.

formulas.name: Charge through the coil
formulas.when: Kitna charge baha (time ka sawal nahi).
formulas.mistake: Yeh kitni tezi se flux badla, us par depend nahi karta.

formulas.name: Motional emf (rod)
formulas.formula: ε = Blv  (B, l, v teeno perpendicular);   general: ε = (v × B)·l
formulas.when: Rod rails par khisak rahi hai.
formulas.mistake: Teeno perpendicular na hon to sirf perpendicular components lo.

formulas.name: Rod on rails with resistance
formulas.formula: I = Blv/R;   magnetic drag F = B²l²v/R;   power = F v = B²l²v²/R
formulas.when: Constant speed ke liye kitna force.
formulas.note: Drag force velocity ke proportional — isliye terminal velocity aati hai.

formulas.name: Rotating rod
formulas.formula: ε = ½Bωl²  (ek end par ghoomti rod)
formulas.note: Do ends ke beech emf; beech mein pivot ho to dono halves ka emf cancel.

formulas.name: AC generator emf
formulas.formula: ε = NBAω sinωt;   peak ε₀ = NBAω
formulas.when: Coil uniform B mein ghoom rahi hai.
formulas.mistake: ω = 2πf radian/sec mein; rpm ko pehle convert karo.

formulas.name: Self inductance
formulas.formula: NΦ = LI;   ε = −L dI/dt;   unit henry
formulas.mistake: L coil ki geometry se aata hai, current par depend nahi karta.

formulas.name: Inductance of a solenoid
formulas.formula: L = μ₀μ_r N²A / l = μ₀μ_r n² A l
formulas.note: N² — turns double to L chaar guna.

formulas.name: Mutual inductance
formulas.formula: N₂Φ₂ = M I₁;   ε₂ = −M dI₁/dt;   co-axial solenoids: M = μ₀ n₁ N₂ A;   M ≤ √(L₁L₂)
formulas.note: M dono coils ke liye same hota hai (M₁₂ = M₂₁).

formulas.name: Energy stored in an inductor
formulas.formula: U = ½LI²;   energy density u = B²/2μ₀
formulas.mistake: Current ka square — voltage se seedha mat nikalo.

formulas.name: LR circuit (growth and decay)
formulas.formula: Growth: I = (E/R)(1 − e^{−t/τ});  decay: I = I₀e^{−t/τ};  τ = L/R
formulas.mistake: t = τ par current final ka 63% hota hai, 50% nahi.

formulas.name: Inductors in series/parallel (no coupling)
formulas.mistake: Resistors jaisa hi, capacitors jaisa nahi.

examples.title: Faraday: average emf
examples.problem: 100 turns ki coil se per-turn flux 0.02 Wb se 0.005 Wb tak 0.1 s mein ghatta hai. Emf?
examples.solution: ε = NΔΦ/Δt = 100 × 0.015/0.1 = 15 V. Flux ghat raha hai ⇒ induced current wahi direction ka field banayega (Lenz).

examples.title: Rails par rod
examples.problem: 0.5 m rod 4 m/s se B = 0.3 T mein khisakti hai, circuit R = 2 Ω. Emf, current, drag force, power?

examples.title: Ghoomti rod
examples.problem: 1 m rod ek end par 20 rad/s se B = 0.5 T (axis ke parallel) mein ghoom rahi hai. Emf?

examples.title: Solenoid ka L
examples.problem: 500 turns, lambai 0.5 m, area 10⁻³ m² (hawa core). L?

examples.title: Self-induced emf aur energy
examples.problem: L = 0.2 H mein current 5 A se 0 tak 0.01 s mein. Emf? 5 A par energy?
examples.solution: ε = L ΔI/Δt = 0.2 × 5/0.01 = 100 V (isliye switch par spark). U = ½LI² = ½ × 0.2 × 25 = 2.5 J.

examples.title: Mutual induction
examples.problem: M = 0.05 H; primary ka current 40 A/s se badal raha hai. Secondary mein emf?

examples.title: Generator ka peak emf
examples.problem: 100 turns, area 0.01 m², B = 0.5 T, coil 50 rev/s se ghoomti hai. Peak emf?

examples.title: Kitna charge baha
examples.problem: 10 turns, R = 5 Ω coil se per-turn flux 0.02 Wb poora hata diya. Kitna charge baha?
examples.solution: Q = NΔΦ/R = 10 × 0.02/5 = 0.04 C — chaahe jaldi hatao ya dheere.

examples.title: LR circuit
examples.problem: L = 2 H, R = 4 Ω, battery 12 V. Time constant, final current, aur t = τ par current?

examples.title: Do solenoids ka M
examples.problem: Lamba solenoid 1000 turns/m; uske andar 100 turns ki chhoti coil, area 2 × 10⁻⁴ m². M?

topics.title: Faraday aur Henry ke experiments
topics.explain: (1) Magnet ko coil ke paas laao/hatao — galvanometer hilta hai; magnet ruka to zero. (2) Paas wali coil mein current on/off karo — doosri coil mein current. (3) Coil ko field mein ghumao. Teeno mein ek hi baat: flux badla to emf.

topics.title: Lenz's law aur energy
topics.explain: Magnet ka north coil ki taraf laao to coil ka saamne wala face north ban jaata hai aur magnet ko dhakelta hai — paas laane mein kaam lagta hai, wahi kaam electrical energy banta hai. Agar current madad karta to free energy milti — impossible.

topics.title: Motional emf ki soch
topics.explain: Rod ke electrons par qvB force lagta hai jo unhe ek end par dhakel deta hai — rod ek battery ban jaati hai. Circuit band ho to current, aur current par BIl drag force jo motion ka virodh karta hai.

topics.title: Eddy currents
topics.explain: Badalte flux se metal plate/core mein gol-gol currents. Fayde: electromagnetic brake (trains), induction furnace, induction cooktop, galvanometer ki damping, speedometer. Nuksaan: heating aur energy loss — isliye transformer aur motor ke core laminated (patli insulated sheets) hote hain.

topics.title: Self induction
topics.explain: Coil electrical inertia jaisi hai: current badhne ya ghatne nahi deti. Switch kholne par current achanak girta hai ⇒ bada emf ⇒ spark. Choke coil AC mein bina energy waste kiye current kam karti hai.

topics.title: Mutual induction
topics.explain: Ek coil ka badalta current doosri coil mein emf. M coils ki doori, orientation aur core par depend karta hai; paas aur same axis = zyada M. Transformer, wireless charger isi par chalte hain.

topics.title: AC generator
topics.explain: Coil uniform B mein ghoomti hai, Φ = NBA cosωt ⇒ ε = NBAω sinωt. Slip rings + brushes se AC bahar aata hai. Mechanical energy (turbine) → electrical energy.

ratta: Rod: ε = Blv;  rotating rod: ½Bωl².
Eddy currents kam karne ke liye laminated core.
